:::{#exr-vector-addition-practice}
#### Adding two months of sales for three items

A shop records how many units of each of three items it sells in a month,
as a [column vector](#def-column-vector) in $\reals^3$.
In two months it sells

$$
\vx = \sbmat{12 \\ 5 \\ 8}
\quad \text{and} \quad
\vy = \sbmat{10 \\ 7 \\ 3}
$$

units.

Find $\vx + \vy$,
the units of each item sold over both months.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @def-vector-addition,
as in @exm-vector-addition.

:::

:::
